text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios was injured during training,
so we rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like I totally went overboard~!!
Total mega oopsie! Ahahaha~~!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, wasn't the teacher's face mad scary?
Like, I almost started bawling my eyes out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And so~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's fes!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ?? Isn't that just how it is??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things get bad,
just laugh it off and blast the tears away!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I totally said bye-bye to that cold with this!
Honestly, this'll be a breeze☆"
choice_data_list: We might end up in a situation that's no laughing matter.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Oh snap!! That reminds me, I totally bawled my eyes out when I couldn't go on a school trip once!!"
choice_data_list: Let's take a proper rest and get better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she took some time off to rest
until her injury was fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hell yeaaah!! Let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, oh man~~! This hurts so much I can't even move!
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We rushed to let Daitaku Helios rest, but...
Her injury healed slowly, and it would take a long time before she could return.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow away the tears and rock the dance floor!
Wahahaha~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Floor Customer
text_block_list.text:
FOO~! DJ Helios is killing it!!
Hype is through the roof~~â

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We're just getting started~~! Put your hands up!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, after the festival, her injury showed remarkable improvement... and she went on to make a smooth comeback!
